messages:
alex: Heads-up — spotted a deprecated routing example in docs/runtime/routing.md that still shows `redwood.route()` (old v1 API). It breaks the sample curl and the code block links to a 404. Anyone owns that page? /cc @maia @jia

docs-bot: Automated link-scan flagged /docs/runtime/routing.md: line 42 → http://internal.cdn/redwood/v1/examples 404. Report ID: scan-20260321-42

maia: oof. I remember we moved samples to /examples/new-routing in Q4. I can open a tiny PR to update code and link. Does anyone want to review? :+1:

jia: pls include the test curl I used: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` — updated example should use `redwood.client().route({...})` not `redwood.route()`

sam: I can review tomorrow morning. Quick question — do we need to keep the old v1 snippet behind a note or remove?

alex: prefer remove + add migration note. We don't want users to copy a broken snippet. Add a small callout: 'Deprecated: v1 legacy' and link to migration guide. Also can we add a CI smoke test that curls the sample link? If it's simple, add me as reviewer.

maia: sg. I'll PR: change snippet, update link, add a one-liner in migration guide, and add a test in docs/checks/sample_links.sh. Will ping when done. ETA EOD.

jia: for the smoke test, sample_links.sh can use `httpie` or `curl` — prefer curl for CI. Example: `curl -fsS https://redwood.dev/examples/new-routing || exit 1`

docs-bot: Noted. I'll add this doc to next link-scan run and post status. scan-queue updated.

alex: thx. @sam when maia posts PR, can you give a quick CR? Tag me for migration note check. :coffee:

sam: yup, will check.

maia: PR opened — #1284 updates routing.md, removes v1 snippet, adds migration note, and adds sample_links.sh. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1284 — ready for review.
